snippet.title: Evercade - Taito Arcade 1 and 2 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to take the arcade action with you, with 18 all-time Taito Arcade classics across two Evercade cartridge collections! 

Taito Arcade 1 includes the legendary SPACE INVADERS and the beloved BUBBLE BOBBLE, plus DON DOKO DON, GROWL, THE LEGEND OF KAGE and more!

Taito Arcade 2 includes the classic shooter OPERATION WOLF,  THE NEWZEALAND STORY, RASTAN, and many more! 

Release: September 2025
Pre-order: July 30th, 2025

Find out more:
Taito Arcade 1: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/taito-arcade-1/
Taito Arcade 2: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/taito-arcade-2/
